answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the marble of a task receipt, and the relic is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the horizon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
